faqs.a:
Section 108.4. Violation penalties,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
108.4. Violation penalties.
Any violation of the mechanical code shall be punishable by a fine, or imprisonment,
                  or both, not to exceed the limits established in
Section 1-5
of the Arvada City Code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 10, 9-14-2020)
